title: an action that cannot complete without calling itself is rejected
purpose: Every path of spin calls spin before it could complete.

rejection.justification: §11.6.1: an action that cannot complete without recursing is a semantic error.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: §11.6.1: spin has no path to completion that avoids the recursive call (integer + and - cannot fail).
